subject: ci: add GitHub Actions workflow for v4 build (Release Portable x64)
body:
ci: add GitHub Actions workflow for v4 build (Release Portable x64)

Стадия C1 (вариант B). Workflow для ветки v4: setup-msbuild + msbuild
Release Portable x64 -> portable zip artifact. Триггер на push в v4.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
patch:
--- .github/workflows/passive-rdp-monitor-1772-v4.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+name: Passive RDP Monitor 1.77.2 v4
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - passive-rdp-monitor-1772-v4
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: windows-2022
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Setup .NET 6
+        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
+        with:
+          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'
+
+      - name: Setup MSBuild
+        uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2
+
+      - name: Restore main project only
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: dotnet restore .\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG.csproj
+
+      - name: Build portable x64
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: msbuild .\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG.csproj /m /p:Configuration="Release Portable" /p:Platform="x64" /p:SolutionDir="$env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE\" /verbosity:minimal
+
+      - name: Prepare artifact directory
+        shell: pwsh
+        run: |
+          $source = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE "mRemoteNG\bin\x64\Release Portable"
+          $out = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE "_publish\mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-1772-v4-win-x64"
+          if (!(Test-Path $source)) {
+            Write-Host "Build output not found at $source"
+            if (Test-Path .\mRemoteNG\bin) { Get-ChildItem -Recurse .\mRemoteNG\bin | Select-Object FullName }
+            exit 1
+          }
+          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null
+          Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $source "*") -Destination $out -Recurse -Force
+          Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $out "*") -DestinationPath "$out.zip" -Force
+
+      - name: Upload portable zip
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-1772-v4-win-x64
+          path: _publish/mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-1772-v4-win-x64.zip
+          if-no-files-found: error
--- HANDOFF.md
@@ -238,7 +238,8 @@ capture асинхронно) во всех путях reconnect.
   (error MSB4803). Нужен **MSBuild .NET Framework** (VS Build Tools 2022, как в CI:
   `microsoft/setup-msbuild`). .NET 6 SDK установлен (6.0.428), но его недостаточно. Сборка
   упала на resolve COM **до** компиляции C# — изменения A2–B5 компилятором ещё НЕ проверены.
-  Варианты: (A) установить VS Build Tools 2022 локально; (B) собрать через GitHub Actions.
+  **Выбрано (B): GitHub Actions** — добавлен workflow `passive-rdp-monitor-1772-v4.yml`
+  (триггер push в v4; msbuild Release Portable x64), ветка v4 запушена в origin для сборки.
 
 ---

security_flags.reason: CI workflow changes are the primary supply-chain vector (pull_request_target abuse, workflow injection)

triage.rationale: CI workflow specific to a third-party passive RDP branch; irrelevant to our existing .NET 10 pipeline.
